# P26.8 — dot_511 hosted ingest: land the state camera feeds in the spine

Closes `D-SOURCES.7-3`. The P26.7 connector produced 84,254 locally-verified
claims across 8 state DOT/511 feeds but never reached the hosted spine — the
`sig-ingest-dot-511-*` jobs existed only as cadence rows. This ticket deploys
and runs them.

## What landed

- **All 8 jobs + schedulers deployed** — `sig-ingest-dot-511-{ky,il,ut,or,ia,wa,dc,mo}`
  + monthly `sig-sched-*` triggers, same env/secret pattern as the existing fleet
  (no new secrets — ArcGIS endpoints are keyless). Per-job upserts used verbatim;
  `scheduled-ops.sh` untouched (host ADC file is corrupt JSON — user account is
  fully authed; recorded, not worked around).
- **All 8 states executed into the hosted spine** — committed fetch records
  `docs/build/reports/live_runs/2026-09-17_dot_511_*_p268.json`; WORM run rows
  under `gs://…-sig-restricted/ops/runs/dot_511_*/`.
- **Spine: 32,064 → 108,016 claims** (75,952 dot_511 rows; includes the recorded
  +288 UT digest-rebaseline set — append-only, never deleted).
- **`retrieved_date` volatile-digest defect fixed** — same defect class P26.6
  fixed for `capture_digest`: a per-run timestamp inside claim evidence churns
  `content_digest` and mints duplicates on every re-run. Removed from claim
  evidence (the timestamp stays durable on `evidence_capture.retrieved_at` +
  the fetch record); regression test added. One re-baseline absorbed now so
  October monthly runs dedupe.
- Image rebuilt + pushed linux/amd64 with the connector (Docker daemon hung
  once mid-build; restarted, second push clean).
